title: Copying a Word to an Empty Tape
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $q,q'$ be states, and let $w$ assign a Boolean word to each of the $k$ work tapes. Choose source and destination tape indices, and suppose the destination word is empty. Starting from the configuration determined by $q$ and $w$, replace the state by $q'$ and replace the destination tape's cells from position $0$ through position $|w_{m src}|-1$ with the source word, leaving all other tape cells and all other configuration data unchanged. The resulting configuration is the one determined by $q'$ and the family of words obtained by replacing the destination word with the source word.
hypotheses_covered: A nonnegative number $k$ of work tapes
A family of Boolean words indexed by the work tapes
